# `sesam doctor` runs the installation health checks and prints a structured
# report + summary. Smoke test only: doctor covers installation, not repository
# integrity (that is `sesam verify`).
#
# A default `sesam init` (no --install-merge) must give doctor a clean exit:
# the .gitattributes check renders the per-repo driver suffix before diffing,
# and the opt-in branch-merge git-config is a warning, not a blocking issue.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

exec sesam doctor
stdout '# sesam doctor'
stdout '## System'
stdout '## Git'
stdout '## Summary'

# The clipboard check reports what `sesam show --clip` would actually pick.
# With the env overrides in place it must name them rather than probe the
# system, which is also how it stays green on a headless CI box.
env SESAM_CLIPBOARD_COPY_CMD=$WORK/copy.sh
env SESAM_CLIPBOARD_PASTE_CMD=$WORK/paste.sh
exec sesam doctor
stdout 'clipboard: using --clipboard-copy-cmd and --clipboard-paste-cmd'

# The flags are the same setting under another name.
env SESAM_CLIPBOARD_COPY_CMD=
env SESAM_CLIPBOARD_PASTE_CMD=
exec sesam --clipboard-copy-cmd $WORK/copy.sh --clipboard-paste-cmd $WORK/paste.sh doctor
stdout 'clipboard: using --clipboard-copy-cmd and --clipboard-paste-cmd'

# Half a pair is a configuration error, not a working clipboard.
exec sesam --clipboard-copy-cmd $WORK/copy.sh doctor
stdout 'clipboard: `sesam show --clip` has no way to reach the clipboard'
stdout 'must be set together'

-- copy.sh --
#!/bin/sh
cat > /dev/null
-- paste.sh --
#!/bin/sh
true
